publisher_name: Based Istanbul Kültür Dergi Yayıncılık ve Pazarlama Limited Şirketi
independence_evidence: Published by its own small Istanbul company (Based Istanbul Kültür Dergi Yayıncılık ve Pazarlama Ltd. Şti., per the shop's distance-sales contract); the about page describes Based Istanbul as a self-run platform that also operates a creative agency (BI Creative). No media group involved.
qualifies_reason: Independent Istanbul-made bilingual print magazine whose No 46 was published in June 2026 and is on sale in the publisher's shop.
what_it_is: Based Istanbul is a bilingual (Turkish and English) magazine about Istanbul's creative scene, mixing fashion, art, architecture, design, film and music through interviews, portraits and photo stories. Each issue is themed and released with several covers featuring Turkish actors, musicians and other public figures alongside international names; No 46 is themed 'ICONS, redefined'. It suits readers following Turkish fashion and popular culture and the people shaping it.

cover_candidates.notes: Flat front cover used as the lead image on the publisher's issue page (woman with hair buns in patterned dress). Measured with identify.
Flat alternative cover (close-up face). Also used by KD Presse. Measured with identify.

uncertainties: Issue date: the publisher's No 46 post is dated 19 June 2026 and the cover files were uploaded June 2026; KD Presse listed it 1 July 2026. Used the publisher's post date.

Frequency: the publisher says biannual ('6 aylık'), but the recent cadence is No 44 (Dec 2024), No 45 (Dec 2025) and No 46 (Jun 2026), i.e. roughly three issues in two years. Recorded biannual per the publisher; actual output has been slower.
Cover price is 1600 TL in the Turkish shop (international orders go via KD Presse at EUR 35). Trim size and page count are not stated.
Which of the four covers belongs to which cover guest is not labelled; the shop lists four No 46 products all titled with cover guest Hande Erçel.
